query: I just spent the whole morning trying out the new sourdough bakery that opened up down the street, their lavender honey loaf is so fluffy and sweet I ended up buying two extra loaves to drop off for my neighbors later. On my walk back I saw a group of kids setting up a lemonade stand in the park, they had little hand-drawn signs and were giving out free dog treats to anyone who stopped by, it was so cute I stopped for a cup even though I don’t usually drink lemonade. I also just remembered my favorite podcast is dropping a new episode this afternoon about vintage camera restoration, I’ve been waiting for weeks to listen to it since I just picked up an old 35mm film camera at a flea market last weekend. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone right now: my mobile data isn’t working at all even though I tried adjusting my APN settings, I can’t send or receive calls or texts, I was also told there might be an overdue bill holding up my service, and I think the SIM card might have come loose when I dropped my phone earlier, can you help me fix this?
